demos.title: Angular CLI MCP Server
demos.teaches: Register the Angular CLI MCP server and browse the nine tools it exposes, with run_target and the three devserver tools stable as of 22.1. See what --read-only and --local-only drop, and copy the config for Claude Code or VS Code.

demos.title: Harness Files
demos.teaches: Compare CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md side by side, written from the rules get_best_practices actually returns for Angular 22. Understand scope, precedence, per-turn cost and what belongs in a skill instead.

demos.title: Agent Skills
demos.teaches: Weigh the official Angular Agent Skills against this repo's own angular-conventions skill and see which one wins per question. Then build a SKILL.md and watch the frontmatter description that does the routing.

demos.title: Angular Expert Agent
demos.teaches: Define a specialized subagent in .claude/agents with its own frontmatter, tool allowlist and model. Sort rules into the agent file or a skill, and decide which prompts get routed to it at all.

demos.title: Hooks & Quality Gates
demos.teaches: Wire settings.json hooks that enforce what instructions only ask for: format on write with PostToolUse, block a banned Angular API with PreToolUse, and refuse to end a session on a red build with Stop.

markdownItems.title: Agentic workflow notes
markdownItems.comment: Delegate subject matter work to the owning expert agent instead of grinding on the main thread.

markdownItems.title: Spec before code
markdownItems.comment: A written contract of types and signatures makes a wrong fan-out visibly wrong.
